nodes.title: Fourier entropy and the entropy-influence conjecture
nodes.body: The Fourier entropy of a Boolean $f$ is $H[\hat f^2]=\sum_S\hat f(S)^2\log(1/\hat f(S)^2)$; the Fourier Entropy-Influence conjecture (Friedgut-Kalai) asserts $H[\hat f^2]\le C\,I(f)$ for an absolute constant $C$.

nodes.title: Fourier entropy-influence: reduction to small-influence functions, a 7.05 floor for restriction inductions, and read-once formulas over AND, OR, XOR, NOT
nodes.body: The Fourier entropy-influence conjecture is equivalent to its restriction to Boolean functions all of whose influences are below any fixed tau: a coordinate of influence at least tau has restriction drop Delta_i <= (2/ln 2 + log2(e/tau)) Inf_i, so a violation localizes to a subcube on which every influence is small and the restriction step fails at every coordinate. On self-compositions of Numaro's record function the restriction-step constant rho_0 = min_i Delta_i/Inf_i is 6.3290, 6.8901 and 7.0519 at 324, 5832 and 104976 variables (limit about 7.1116), so no potential-free coordinate induction can give a constant below 7.05. The XOR gate inequality is certified, so read-once formulas over AND, OR, XOR and NOT satisfy H <= 6.4573 I; a prime monotone 7-input gate breaks the read-once potential behind that bound; the five prime 3-input classes (one-hot, MAJ3, EQ3, MUX, Q3) are proved, while fan-in 3 at 6.4573 in general is numerical only. Per-coordinate erasure bounds fail even for monotone functions (majority with one flipped point gives ratio at least (n - 3 log2 n)/2). The full conjecture remains open.

nodes.body: For the FEI restriction-step constant rho_0 (the open key inequality of the Gonzalez-MacManus-Pereyra approach (arXiv:2606.00246)): sup rho_0 >= C_FEI, so any restriction-step proof must reach at least 6.5218, the best known FEI lower bound (Numaro 2026; Hod's read-once 6.4548 before it); the ceiling rho_0 <= (1 + h(delta))/delta forces the maximum influence of an extremal step below 0.2894; and descending a restriction tree produces the witness rho_0 = 6.3164 at n = 71, against the previously best known 6.08.

assumptions: the GMP restriction-step formulation of FEI
h the binary entropy function; delta the restricted coordinate's bias
the descent witness is a computed example at n = 71
claim.statement: For the FEI restriction-step constant rho_0 (the open key inequality of the Gonzalez-MacManus-Pereyra approach (arXiv:2606.00246)): sup rho_0 >= C_FEI, so any restriction-step proof must reach at least 6.5218, the best known FEI lower bound (Numaro 2026; Hod's read-once 6.4548 before it); the ceiling rho_0 <= (1 + h(delta))/delta forces the maximum influence of an extremal step below 0.2894; and descending a restriction tree produces the witness rho_0 = 6.3164 at n = 71, against the previously best known 6.08.
